evidence.title: Running AV Reasoning Models Within Onboard Compute and Latency Limits
evidence.excerpt: Robotics Running AV Reasoning Models Within Onboard Compute and Latency Limits Nov 10, 2026 By Marco Pavone and Boris Ivanovic Discuss (0) L T F R E AI-Generated Summary NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Edge is a 2B-parameter adaptive reasoning vision-language-action model designed for real-time operation on NVIDIA DRIVE AGX Thor. The model generates Chain-of-Causation reasoning only when needed and uses a diffusion action expert to produce driving trajectories from surround-camera observations and navigation inputs. Closed-loop reinforcement learning in AlpaGym improves driving performance by 48.9% over the best checkpoint without closed-loop RL. AlpaJudge provides human-calibrated evaluation of reasoning quality through reference-based and reference-free variants for different evidence types. Three workflows connect the edge model with repeatable improvement: running AlpaJudge on PhysicalAI-AV samples, selecting higher-value training examples, and using reasoning scores as rewards for post-training. Deployment recipes in the Alpamayo Developer Hub enable inference optimization with TensorRT and DFlash2, achieving 160-190 ms pixel-to-trajectory latency on DRIVE AGX Thor. Next Steps Explore the A
